# ST lsm6dsox-pid (vendored, reference only)

- Source: https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/lsm6dsox-pid
- Commit: `2e86793125f7f46b6195fce93a2b3cb76a51e564` (master, 2026-10-13)
- Files: `lsm6dsox_reg.h` (unmodified), `LICENSE` (BSD-3-Clause, STMicroelectronics 2019)

The header is **not compiled** into physicalSetup. It is the citation target for the register constants in
`common/include/rig/drivers/imu/lsm6dsox_regs.hpp` ("ST reg.h:<line>"). The datasheet used alongside it is
DS12814 Rev 4 (June 2024; the LSM6DSOX datasheet's real document number).
